This reference is generated from the Rust command and session catalogs used by Workdeck itself. Run `workdeck --help` or `workdeck <command> --help` for the installed version.

## Global options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | Show top-level or command-specific help. |
| `-V, --version` | Print the installed Workdeck version. |
| `--cwd <path>` | Resolve repository and local state from this path (default: `.`). |
| `--extension <path>` | Load a native extension manifest or directory (repeatable). |
| `--no-extensions` | Disable user extensions for this run. |
| `--experimental` | Enable experimental review features such as STML. |
| `--fast` | Use experimental fast syntax highlighting. |

## Common review options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--mode <auto\|split\|stack>` | Select responsive, side-by-side, or stacked review layout. |
| `--watch` | Reload supported review inputs when their source changes. |
| `--agent-context <path>` | Load a JSON sidecar with agent rationale. |
| `--pager` | Use pager-style review chrome. |
| `--line-numbers / --no-line-numbers` | Show or hide old and new line numbers. |
| `-x, --tab-width <columns>` | Set terminal tab stops from 1 through 16 (default: 4). |
| `--file-gap <rows>` | Set file separator rows from 0 through 8 (default: 1). |
| `--hunk-gap <rows>` | Set blank rows before later hunks from 0 through 8 (default: 0). |
| `--wrap / --no-wrap` | Wrap or truncate long diff lines. |
| `--hunk-headers / --no-hunk-headers` | Show or hide hunk metadata rows. |
| `--sidebar / --no-sidebar` | Show or hide the files pane. |
| `--agent-notes / --no-agent-notes` | Show or hide agent notes. |
| `--transparent-bg / --no-transparent-bg` | Use transparent or themed surfaces. |
| `--theme <theme>` | Select a bundled, extension, or custom theme. |

## `workdeck diff`

Review working-tree, staged, revision-range, or concrete-file changes.

### Usage

```bash
workdeck diff [REVISION] [-- <pathspec...>]
workdeck diff <FROM> <TO> [-- <pathspec...>]
workdeck diff --staged [-- <pathspec...>]
workdeck diff --files <LEFT> <RIGHT>
```

Also accepts the common review options and `--watch`.

## `workdeck show`

Review the last commit or a given revision.

### Usage

```bash
workdeck show [TARGET] [-- <pathspec...>]
```

Also accepts the common review options and `--watch`.

## `workdeck stash show`

Review a Git stash entry as a complete changeset.

### Usage

```bash
workdeck stash show [REF]
```

Also accepts the common review options and `--watch`.

## `workdeck patch`

Review a patch file or read a unified patch from stdin.

### Usage

```bash
workdeck patch [FILE]
```

Also accepts the common review options and `--watch`.

## `workdeck pager`

Wrap a Git pager invocation and detect its diff input.

### Usage

```bash
workdeck pager
```

Also accepts the common review options and `--watch`.

## `workdeck difftool`

Review a Git difftool file pair.

### Usage

```bash
workdeck difftool <LEFT> <RIGHT> [PATH]
```

Also accepts the common review options and `--watch`.

## Live sessions

The loopback session broker exposes review, context, navigation, reload, comment, highlight, and quit controls without taking ownership of the interactive TUI.

### `session list`

list live Workdeck sessions

```text
workdeck session list [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

### `session get`

show one live Workdeck session

```text
workdeck session get (<session-id> | --repo <path>) [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[sessionId]`.

### `session context`

show the selected file and hunk for one live Workdeck session

```text
workdeck session context (<session-id> | --repo <path>) [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[sessionId]`.

### `session review`

export the live review model for one Workdeck session

```text
workdeck session review (<session-id> | --repo <path>) [--include-patch] [--include-notes] [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--include-patch` | include raw unified diff text for each file in review output |
| `--include-notes` | include live review notes in review output |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[sessionId]`.

### `session navigate`

move a live Workdeck session to one diff hunk

```text
workdeck session navigate (<session-id> | --repo <path>) --file <path> (--hunk <n> | --old-line <n> | --new-line <n>) [--json]
workdeck session navigate (<session-id> | --repo <path>) --comment <id> [--json]
workdeck session navigate (<session-id> | --repo <path>) (--next-comment | --prev-comment) [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--file <path>` | diff file path as shown by Workdeck |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--hunk <n>` | 1-based hunk number within the file |
| `--old-line <n>` | 1-based line number on the old side |
| `--new-line <n>` | 1-based line number on the new side |
| `--comment <id>` | jump to the live comment with this id |
| `--next-comment` | jump to the next annotated hunk |
| `--prev-comment` | jump to the previous annotated hunk |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[sessionId]`.

Examples:

```text
workdeck session navigate --repo . --file src/App.tsx --hunk 2
workdeck session navigate --repo . --file src/App.tsx --new-line 372
workdeck session navigate --repo . --file src/App.tsx --old-line 355
workdeck session navigate --repo . --comment comment-1
workdeck session navigate --repo . --next-comment
workdeck session navigate --repo . --prev-comment
```

### `session reload`

replace the contents of one live Workdeck session

```text
workdeck session reload (<session-id> | --repo <path> | --session-path <path>) [--source <path>] [--json] -- diff [ref] [-- <pathspec...>]
workdeck session reload (<session-id> | --repo <path> | --session-path <path>) [--source <path>] [--json] -- show [ref] [-- <pathspec...>]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--session-path <path>` | target a live session rooted at a different path |
| `--source <path>` | load the diff from this directory instead of the session's own |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[sessionId]`.

Examples:

```text
workdeck session reload --repo . -- diff
workdeck session reload --repo . -- diff main...feature -- src/ui
workdeck session reload --repo . -- show HEAD~1
workdeck session reload --repo . -- show HEAD~1 -- README.md
workdeck session reload --repo /path/to/worktree -- diff
workdeck session reload --session-path /path/to/live-window --source /path/to/other-checkout -- diff
```

### `session comment add`

attach one live inline review note

```text
workdeck session comment add (<session-id> | --repo <path>) --file <path> (--old-line <n> | --new-line <n>) --summary <text> [--rationale <text>] [--author <name>] [--markup <stml>] [--focus] [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--file <path>` | diff file path as shown by Workdeck Required. |
| `--summary <text>` | short review note Required. |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--old-line <n>` | 1-based line number on the old side |
| `--new-line <n>` | 1-based line number on the new side |
| `--rationale <text>` | optional longer explanation |
| `--markup <stml>` | experimental STML body (target session must opt in) |
| `--author <name>` | optional author label |
| `--focus` | add the note and focus the viewport on it |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[sessionId]`.

Examples:

```text
workdeck session comment add --repo . --file README.md --new-line 103 --summary "Tighten this wording"
```

### `session comment apply`

apply many live inline review notes from stdin JSON

```text
workdeck session comment apply (<session-id> | --repo <path>) --stdin [--focus] [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--stdin` | read the comment batch from stdin as JSON |
| `--focus` | apply the batch and focus the first note |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[sessionId]`.

Examples:

```text
printf '%s\n' '{"comments":[{"filePath":"README.md","newLine":103,"summary":"Tighten this wording"}]}' | workdeck session comment apply --repo . --stdin
```

### `session comment list`

list live inline review notes

```text
workdeck session comment list (<session-id> | --repo <path>) [--file <path>] [--type <live|all|ai|agent|user>] [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--file <path>` | filter comments to one diff file |
| `--type <type>` | filter to live, all, ai, agent, or user comments |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[sessionId]`.

### `session comment rm`

remove one inline review note

```text
workdeck session comment rm (<session-id> | --repo <path>) <comment-id> [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[targets...]` — <session-id> <comment-id>, or <comment-id> with --repo.

### `session comment clear`

clear inline review notes

```text
workdeck session comment clear (<session-id> | --repo <path>) [--file <path>] [--include-user|--all] --yes [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--file <path>` | clear only one diff file's comments |
| `--include-user` | also clear human notes created with the TUI `c` action |
| `--all` | clear both live agent comments and human user notes |
| `--yes` | confirm destructive comment clearing |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[sessionId]`.

### `session highlight add`

paint one attention mark inside a diff line

```text
workdeck session highlight add (<session-id> | --repo <path>) --file <path> (--old-line <n> | --new-line <n>) --start <n> --end <n> [--tone <tone>] [--focus] [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--file <path>` | diff file path as shown by Workdeck Required. |
| `--start <n>` | 0-based inclusive start offset into the line's text (UTF-16 code units) Required. |
| `--end <n>` | exclusive end offset; must be greater than --start Required. |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--old-line <n>` | 1-based line number on the old side |
| `--new-line <n>` | 1-based line number on the new side |
| `--tone <tone>` | mark tone: match, current, info, warning, error, dim (default match) |
| `--focus` | add the mark and land the viewport on its line |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[sessionId]`.

Examples:

```text
workdeck session highlight add --repo . --file src/App.tsx --new-line 42 --start 6 --end 19
workdeck session highlight add --repo . --file src/App.tsx --new-line 42 --start 6 --end 19 --tone warning --focus
```

### `session highlight clear`

clear agent attention marks

```text
workdeck session highlight clear (<session-id> | --repo <path>) [--file <path>] [--json]
```

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--repo <path>` | target the live session whose repo root matches this path |
| `--file <path>` | clear only one diff file's marks |
| `--json` | emit structured JSON |

Positionals: `[sessionId]`.

Examples:

```text
workdeck session highlight clear --repo .
```


## Workdeck capabilities

### `workdeck status`

Print a Git status snapshot.

```text
workdeck status [--json]
```

### `workdeck files`

Inspect repository files without opening the TUI.

```text
workdeck files <list|show|preview> ...
```

### `workdeck changes`

Inspect headless changes and preserve JSON/JSONL output.

```text
workdeck changes diff [OPTIONS]
```

### `workdeck search`

Search files, changes, issues, and agent data.

```text
workdeck search <QUERY> [--target ...] [--json]
```

### `workdeck config`

Inspect and update Workdeck configuration.

```text
workdeck config <show|path|set|reset> ...
```

### `workdeck events`

Inspect the append-only Workdeck event log.

```text
workdeck events <list|export> ...
```

### `workdeck import`

Validate or import Workdeck JSON data.

```text
workdeck import <PATH> [--dry-run|--merge|--replace]
```

### `workdeck export`

Export Workdeck data as JSON or JSONL.

```text
workdeck export [--json|--jsonl]
```

### `workdeck doctor`

Validate repository, configuration, and local Workdeck data.

```text
workdeck doctor [--json]
```

### `workdeck issue`

Manage local Workdeck issues.

```text
workdeck issue <list|show|add|edit|close> ...
```

### `workdeck agent`

Manage local agent sessions.

```text
workdeck agent <list|show|add|edit|remove> ...
```

### `workdeck project`

Manage local Workdeck projects.

```text
workdeck project <list|show|add|edit|archive> ...
```

### `workdeck cycle`

Manage local Workdeck cycles.

```text
workdeck cycle <list|show|add|edit|close> ...
```

### `workdeck label`

Manage local Workdeck labels.

```text
workdeck label <list|add|edit|remove> ...
```

### `workdeck migrate`

Migrate legacy review-tool data without dual-reading after success.

```text
workdeck migrate hunk [--dry-run|--apply]
```

### `workdeck markup`

Render or inspect terminal-safe Workdeck markup.

```text
workdeck markup <render|check> ...
```

### `workdeck skill`

Print or materialize a bundled Workdeck agent skill.

```text
workdeck skill path [NAME]
```

### `workdeck extension`

Manage native Workdeck extensions.

```text
workdeck extension <list|install|update|remove> ...
```

### `workdeck update`

Update Workdeck through the detected installation channel.

```text
workdeck update [VERSION] [--method ...] [--check]
```
